translation:
It's time for the SOS Brigade Summer Training
Camp Part 2!

It all started with that single sentence from
Haruhi…

Ghost stories are as suited to midsummer as
snow is to Christmas!

A classroom which should not exist: "Class
1-10.”

The legend of a "man-eating classroom,”
from which no one who wanders in can return.

As one of the new seven wonders of North
High, we, the SOS Brigade, will investigate it!

Though, no one quite understood the severity
of the situation at this point.
Whoa, whoa… You're kidding… right…?

The entire school's data links have become
unstable.

The emblem drawn by Haruhi Suzumiya acted
as a trigger.

It caused the data lifeforms to increase
their activity.
Just like before.

Our first priority is to investigate the scene.
Let's go, Mikuru!
Y-yes, Suzumiya!

The man-eating classroom, huh? It's simple,
but there's still something scary about it.
A-are we all going to get eaten…?

The first to be attacked is always the villain
or the beautiful maiden—it's a horror staple.
Huhhhh?!

Miss Suzumiya's words and actions are
starting to have an impact on the real world.
What do you mean…?
She's hoping for it.

For a ghost, or a real unnatural phenomenon
to manifest before her eyes.
Ahhh, I'm scaaared!
Nice expression, Mikuru!

It'll look perfect in the SOS Brigade activity
record!

Let's try to divert Miss Suzumiya's attention
to the best of our ability.

As long as Miss Suzumiya is enjoying herself,
the situation shouldn't worsen any further.

Meanwhile, we'll discreetly handle the outbreak
of alternate space—

Well, I suppose you could say everything is as
usual.
Wh-what's this?! This wasn't here before!

Haruhi Suzumiya's words are influencing the
space.
Wh-what should I do, Nagato?!

Singularities securing the space must be
erased.
You're asking me to… do that?
It's okay. I'll support you.
Are you serious…?
About Haruhi
